result.instructions: Tools for Beacon CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which types of records do I have in my CRM?"; "Find all people records added in the last 30 days."; "Show me the donations (payments) recorded this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Beacon CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run beaconcrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run beaconcrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run beaconcrm_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. beaconcrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: beaconcrm_list_record_types
tools.title: List record types and fields
tools.description: List the record types of this Beacon account (people, organisations, payments, custom types, ...) with their fields (keys, types, options). Call this first: the keys are what the other tools take as `entity` and as field names. GET /entity_types.

tools.name: beaconcrm_list_users
tools.title: List account users
tools.description: List the users of the Beacon account (id, role, name, email). Use the inner user.id for 'link to a user' fields. GET /users.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: beaconcrm_list_records
tools.title: List records
tools.description: List records of one type (for example person, organization, payment), one page at a time. Use beaconcrm_filter_records to search by field values. GET /entities/{entity}.

entity.description: Record type key, e.g. person, organization, payment or a custom type such as c_application. See beaconcrm_list_record_types.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

sort_by.description: Field key to sort by, e.g. created_at.

populate.description: Include data from linked records (point-to-another-record fields). Beacon's default applies when omitted.

archived.description: true = list deleted (archived) records instead of active ones.

tools.name: beaconcrm_get_record
tools.title: Get record
tools.description: One record by type and id, with all its fields. GET /entity/{entity}/{id}.

entity.description: Record type key, e.g. person, organization, payment or a custom type such as c_application. See beaconcrm_list_record_types.

populate.description: Include data from linked records (point-to-another-record fields). Beacon's default applies when omitted.

tools.name: beaconcrm_filter_records
tools.title: Filter records
tools.description: Search records of one type with Beacon filter conditions (read-only; it uses POST because the filter is a body). Each condition is {"field", "operator", "value"}. Operators by field type: text == != starts_with ends_with contains not_contains null not_null; select (value is an array) contains not_contains in not_in null not_null; number == != > < null not_null; date date_on date_after date_before date_between (value e.g. "2026-01-01", "last_month", or ["2026-01-01","2026-06-01"]); checkbox == true; point-to-record (value is an array of ids) contains not_contains. Location parts: address.city etc.; emails: emails.email. Conditions can nest as {"filter_conditions": [...], "filter_strictness": "all"|"any"}. Example: [{"field":"emails.email","operator":"==","value":"a@b.org"}]. POST /entities/{entity}/filter.

entity.description: Record type key, e.g. person, organization, payment or a custom type such as c_application. See beaconcrm_list_record_types.

filter_conditions.description: Filter conditions (see the description). An empty list matches every record.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

sort_by.description: Field key to sort by, e.g. created_at.

populate.description: Include data from linked records (point-to-another-record fields). Beacon's default applies when omitted.

archived.description: true = list deleted (archived) records instead of active ones.

tools.name: beaconcrm_create_record
tools.title: Create record
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new record of the given type in the live Beacon database. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two records (use beaconcrm_upsert_record to avoid duplicates). Beacon workflows may run as a result. Invalid field values are rejected with the rule that failed. POST /entity/{entity}.

entity.description: Record type key, e.g. person, organization, payment or a custom type such as c_application. See beaconcrm_list_record_types.

fields.description: Field values keyed by field key, in Beacon's field formats (see beaconcrm_list_record_types for keys). Select and point-to-record fields are ARRAYS (e.g. {"type": ["Donation"], "customer": [1725]}); emails are [{"email", "is_primary"}]; currency is {"value", "currency"}; dates are ISO strings.

tools.name: beaconcrm_update_record
tools.title: Update record
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of ONE existing record. Only the fields you pass are changed; a select or reference field passed as an empty array [] is CLEARED, removing its existing values. The previous values are not kept by this tool. Beacon workflows may run as a result. PATCH /entity/{entity}/{id}.

entity.description: Record type key, e.g. person, organization, payment or a custom type such as c_application. See beaconcrm_list_record_types.

fields.description: Field values keyed by field key, in Beacon's field formats (see beaconcrm_list_record_types for keys). Select and point-to-record fields are ARRAYS (e.g. {"type": ["Donation"], "customer": [1725]}); emails are [{"email", "is_primary"}]; currency is {"value", "currency"}; dates are ISO strings.

tools.name: beaconcrm_upsert_record
tools.title: Create or update record by key field
tools.description: WRITE: create a record, or update the existing one whose key field matches. `primary_field_key` names the field used to find the match (for example "emails" for a person, or "external_id"); `fields` must contain a value for it. If a record matches it is UPDATED with the given fields (an empty array leaves an existing value untouched on upsert); otherwise a new record is created. Beacon workflows may run as a result. PUT /entity/{entity}/upsert.

entity.description: Record type key, e.g. person, organization, payment or a custom type such as c_application. See beaconcrm_list_record_types.

primary_field_key.description: Field key used to match an existing record, e.g. emails or external_id.

fields.description: Field values keyed by field key, in Beacon's field formats (see beaconcrm_list_record_types for keys). Select and point-to-record fields are ARRAYS (e.g. {"type": ["Donation"], "customer": [1725]}); emails are [{"email", "is_primary"}]; currency is {"value", "currency"}; dates are ISO strings.

annotations.title: Create or update record by key field

tools.name: beaconcrm_delete_record
tools.title: Delete record
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE: delete ONE record. Beacon keeps deleted records as 'archived' (listable with archived=true), but this server has no restore tool, so treat the deletion as irreversible. Related data that depends on the record may be affected. It is sent once and never retried. DELETE /entity/{entity}/{id}.

entity.description: Record type key, e.g. person, organization, payment or a custom type such as c_application. See beaconcrm_list_record_types.

id.description: Id of the record to delete.

tools.name: beaconcrm_trigger_export
tools.title: Start an export
tools.description: WRITE: start an export job from an existing export template (created in Beacon). Returns the new export's id with status in_progress; then poll beaconcrm_list_exports with that id until progress is 100 and it carries a download url. Each call starts another job. POST /entity_export/trigger.

entity_export_template_id.description: Id of the export template (shown in the Beacon URL when you view the template).

tools.name: beaconcrm_list_exports
tools.title: List exports
tools.description: List recent export jobs with status, progress (100 = complete) and, when complete, a signed download url. Pass entity_export_id to check one job started by beaconcrm_trigger_export. GET /entity_exports.

entity_export_id.description: Only this export (the id returned by beaconcrm_trigger_export).
